provenance.source: PNOA, Instituto Geográfico Nacional (orthophoto of May 2024, 25 cm)
provenance.notes: Ends of the chequered finish line across the main straight, at the start of the pit buildings, from the left edge line to the pit wall side, looking north-east in the direction of travel. The start gantry and grid are further along the straight; the gate is the finish line, used for lap timing. Checked against GPS laps of this layout recorded in 2025: a flying lap crosses it once at each end, and the logged lap boundaries fall within one GPS fix of the line.

Regional tourism board of the Generalitat Valenciana: main layout 4,005 m, main straight 876 m, 14 turns. The circuit opened on 19 September 1999 (https://www.circuitricardotormo.com/circuito/) and publishes no layout changes, so the layout has a single version.
